# V0-L3: centralized weekly reserve and secondary staleness

## Objective
Implement and demonstrate V0-L3 from the human-owned `2026-11-12-v0-context-lifecycle-design.md`: the primary deterministic control path protects shared account weekly quota at 15% remaining, while independent secondary inactivity clocks warn the primary without imposing research lifetimes. Read PROJECT.md, AGENTS.md, STATUS.md and the complete amendment. Preserve all human-owned requirements verbatim. The amendment supersedes conflicting historical timers and thresholds. V0-L1 and L2 are accepted; L2 integrated at `f9119e31e816e7f83bb475ce01f58a5873f3b6fa`, with reviewed native final/combined evidence. Build on that runtime instead of repeating it.

## Broad approach and scope
Keep one cohesive L3 increment. Reuse/adapt the established controller's actual weekly telemetry calculation and polling/event policy through the research-owned app-server driver; do not couple research to the separate manager controller engine or expand components. The pipeline architect owns exact files/interfaces. Use straightforward Python, existing ownership/cleanup and ordinary Markdown/small runtime records.

Only the primary's deterministic control path reads and monitors account-wide weekly quota. Preflight must establish required weekly telemetry and sufficient allowance before admitting research; refresh during operation. Recognize the real weekly window, multiple quota buckets and incomplete notifications correctly. The value covers shared account consumption, including secondary work. Do not add separate secondary quota polling/grants or mistake cumulative token spending/context occupancy for remaining account allowance. Rollover cannot reset or bypass the policy.

At observed weekly quota remaining <=15%, latch an investigation-wide runtime quota STOP: block all new work, save useful handoffs where feasible, and interrupt/clean owned agents and computations through the common owned cleanup path. Do not invoke or await the opponent, regardless of primary preference. Later quota updates cannot silently unlatch STOP or restart work. Explicit launch and successful quota preflight remain necessary; complete STOP resumption/reopening is L5, not this request. Missing required weekly telemetry blocks admission and must remain distinguishable from an observed cutoff in status, diagnostics and cleanup outcome. Use supported bounded recovery where appropriate; do not guess quota, fail open or invent a scientific decision. Report actual observations and saving/cleanup overshoot honestly, rather than promising exactly 15% remains.

Every newly attached secondary context, including opponent/verifier contexts, starts its own inactivity clock. Reset only on a measured context-length change, in either direction, or fresh successor attachment; repeated unchanged samples and warning emission do not reset it. Use measured length rather than cumulative consumption or rounded/floored occupancy. At every configured interval multiple, default 2700, 5400, 8100... uninterrupted seconds, warn the same logical primary with affected agent and elapsed staleness. Keep clocks independent across tasks and context replacement. Deliver warnings usefully across primary rollover without introducing a message framework. The primary chooses the response. A long computation may legitimately cause warnings; warnings alone never stop, restart or replace an agent/job or assert scientific failure. Missing telemetry is a separate operational condition. Do not add a primary-inactivity watchdog: the human supervises the primary. Keep any human-configurable interval explicit and unavailable for silent agent relaxation.

Preserve accepted L1/L2 logical identity, 55% rollover, handoff usability, cumulative accounting, original job deadlines, immutable document access, human-edit protection across context/job publication, native isolation/authentication, protected inputs and confirmed cleanup. Defaults remain two agents sharing 2048 MiB, zero swap, 128 process/thread tasks and one concurrent job. No fixed scientific investigation/session/demo lifetimes.

## Observable completion criteria
1. Consequential boundary tests cover quota above, exactly at and below 15%, actual weekly-window recognition, multiple buckets, incomplete/missing telemetry, shared consumption, preflight rejection, quota updates during rollover and latched STOP despite later recovery. Only the primary control path monitors quota; secondary output/activity cannot bypass it.
2. A cutoff bypasses scientific review and blocks new contexts, assignments and jobs, saves useful work where possible, interrupts owned agents/computations, and records observed cleanup truthfully. Exercise actual owned processes and realistic save/cleanup failures without fabricated scientific COMPLETE or consensus. Preserve partial artifacts and uncertain ownership reservations.
3. Controlled-clock checks establish independent secondary clocks, resets on both increasing/decreasing measured length and fresh contexts, unchanged samples not resetting, repeated warnings at interval multiples, and useful primary delivery. Warnings alone leave research/jobs active; primary inactivity has no automatic staleness policy. Do not wait hours to exercise these cases.
4. Provide a representative production-path demonstration with the actual authorized app-server weekly telemetry interface plus owned contexts and a short public/test computation. Transparently injected quota/clock observations may exercise cutoff and warning boundaries; distinguish them from real account readings and live native observations. Never deliberately exhaust an account, alter account settings, manufacture science/approval or bypass actual insufficient/missing-quota admission. Demonstrate centralized quota STOP and confirmed real cleanup; native role scenarios may run sequentially within existing caps.
5. Independent pipeline review and required final/combined checks pass. Report exact telemetry basis, material choices, commands, receipts, actual observations, cleanup, refs, limitations and next L4 dependency in `development/requests/v0-l3-quota-staleness.md` and accurate README/index updates. Existing accepted capabilities remain available or superseded operational state is clearly rejected without migration. L3 does not accept the full lifecycle or M5.

## Validation and management ownership
Pipeline owns implementation, consequential tests, code review and demonstration. The manager trusts its reports and will not independently repeat completed product tests/review. Reuse MCP dependencies at `/home/francesco/Desktop/gits/research_project/research_pipeline/coding_pipeline/logs/20261111T063907_2732fff6/runtime/tmp/test-dependencies/` with `PYTHONPATH=src:<that directory>` rather than reinstalling. Trusted host has the existing authorized user bus, native file authentication, Bubblewrap and cgroup v2; restricted Writer missing-bus failures remain truthful diagnostics, not permission to escape isolation.

Provide/use opt-in discovery gate `RESEARCH_PIPELINE_V0_L3_NATIVE=1`, with private unique receipts under inherited `RESEARCH_PIPELINE_V0_L3_OUTPUT_DIR`. Enabled missing prerequisites fail visibly. Trusted final/combined stages inherit that gate; reserve a fresh output directory per invocation and preserve all failed receipts. Keep M1-M5 live gates and accepted L1/L2 native gates disabled routinely; repeat an accepted native gate only when changed behavior genuinely requires it. Engineering fixture markers belong in fixture projects, never the controller repository root. Operational RPC/test/shutdown bounds may fail a test honestly; they never become scientific lifetimes or scientific completion.

**STATUS.md is manager-owned for this request: leave it unchanged.** Put implementation outcomes in the report, update README and relevant agent-managed directory indexes as needed. This avoids the demonstrated overlap between live manager checkpoints and feature documentation. Do not modify PROJECT.md, engineering AGENTS.md or the human lifecycle amendment. No remote Git actions/publication from pipeline roles; local integration is authorized by the frozen config.

## Constraints and non-goals
Follow PROJECT.md scientific rigor/provenance/security and AGENTS.md: established libraries, direct ordinary files, small reversible designs; abstractions only for demonstrated requirements/duplication; realistic error handling and consequential tests. Remove superseded complexity where justified. No migrations, compatibility shims, universal frameworks, database/broker, per-secondary quota accounting, automatic quota-reset resumption, scientific-progress scoring, controller expansion or component-branch merging.

Preserve retained M5 branch `cwi/20261111T063907_2732fff6` at `1b70aea25f6c5f8496acdea12e9a27c6f3d4ecbd` and its worktree. Do not resume, reset, approve or merge it. No private benchmark investigation or inputs in this increment. Protected `research_example/starting_evidence/`, archived preliminary science and historical receipts remain unchanged. L4 scientific opposition/terminal decisions, L5 reopening/recovery, and L6 integrated validation/M5 harness reconciliation remain later milestones. No repeat accepted paid M1-M4 demonstrations, speculative infrastructure or model substitution. Human scientific acceptance remains mandatory for M5. Resolve ordinary engineering choices autonomously and disclose concrete blockers precisely.
